articles.summary: Zep v4 is the Context API for agents: graph navigation, Ingestion Traces and stable error codes in the API, plus a step-by-step path from v3.
articles.title: Zep v4: the Context API for agents

articles.summary: Zep v4 adds hyperedges. When one fact relates three or more entities, a search that matches one of them returns the full fact, with every related entity.
articles.title: Hyperedges: accurate answers when a fact has many entities
